messages:
Katy: Heads-up — Helix SI + HyperscaleCloud joint announce next month. Need final SI co-sell routing and account mapping by EOD Friday. Who can own the mapping + claim window? :spiral_calendar:
Marcus: I can own the claim window process. Will need final account list + priority tiers. ETA for the list?
Katy: @Marcus sending the seed list in a sec. We need rules: 1) SI retains ownership if they have any active opportunity in SFDC in last 90d, 2) Redwood owns pure self-serve accounts, 3) co-sell split if both have high-touch involvement. Thoughts?
Ana: Agree with the 90d rule. For split accounts we should require an explicit co-sell play registration in the marketplace before handoff. Otherwise default to SI for engagement.
Leo: FYI Helix provided their top 40 target accounts (sensitive). I exported and redacted non-overlap, uploading now.
partner-bot: file uploaded: helix_targets_redacted.csv
Marcus: Received. Quick check: can we apply territory carve rules for EMEA vs NA? Helix wants EMEA leads routed to their EMEA AE first.
Katy: Yes — routing policy: region override > active-opportunity rule > marketplace registration. So EMEA override takes precedence. Documenting in playbook.
Ana: For playbook, include an automatic 72h claim window after announce where SI can claim via the intake form. After 72h unclaimed accounts become Redwood-managed inbound leads. 72h keeps momentum but prevents indefinite hold.
Leo: Sounds fair. One question: what about accounts with existing dedicated contracts (Helix has 3 customers with infra deals)? They should be SI-owned regardless.
Marcus: Add exception: contracted customers flagged in SFDC with "partner_contract" tag remain SI-owned. I'll add validation to claim workflow.
Katy: I'll draft the short rules email and the intake form link. Can someone review the wording before send?
Ana: I can review. Also add a checklist for pre-demo enablement: marketplace listing, solution brief, and Helix contact card.
Marcus: Draft contents look good. On the mapping CSV we used these columns: account_name, redwood_owner, helix_contact, status. Example snippet:
```
account_name,redwood_owner,helix_contact,status
Acme Corp,,helix_j.santos,unclaimed
Northwind,marcus,helix_l.chen,claimed-by-sf
```
Katy: Nice. Leo — can you confirm Helix will enforce NDA on the shared list? We need to ensure no external sharing.
Leo: Confirmed. Helix legal flagged NDA and they'll append the joint-announce addendum.
Marcus: I'll wire the claim form flow: slack notifier to #partnerships when an account is claimed, and auto-tag in SFDC. Will also set up a 72h timer that expires and notifies ops.
Katy: Great. Final ask: everyone OK if we run a quick intake dry-run tomorrow 10am PT with a test account?
Ana: Yes, I'll join.
Leo: I'll be there and bring Helix PM on the call.
Marcus: Confirmed. I'll demo the claim flow.
Katy: Thanks all — I'll post the final playbook + intake link after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
